title: Inviting friends
summary: Let your friends join your Burning Empires server.

sections.heading: Send the invite
steps: Look at Addresses your friends can use on the Dashboard. Each address has a Copy button.
Click Copy invite. It puts a short message for Discord on your clipboard, without the password.
Tell friends the password yourself, if you set one under Give this to friends.

sections.heading: How friends join
steps: Friends use the Coodsz Burning Empires Client Launcher.
They click Direct, type your address and UDP port 4200, then Connect.
They pick the same setup as you, or the server turns the join down.
sections.tip: On the same Wi Fi, friends use your 192.168 address. On this PC you can join with 127.0.0.1.

sections.heading: If friends cannot reach you
steps: Tick Open the port on my router automatically. It opens UDP 4200 while the server runs.
Click Allow through firewall to add the Windows Firewall rule.
Radmin VPN or Hamachi also work. Friends use the address the VPN gives you.
For a Steam lobby, tick Advertise through Steam. Friends then type your Steam profile name.

sections.heading: Players
steps: Online players shows who is on. Refresh updates the list.
Kick player, Ban player and Unban player are under that list.
